To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the existing analytic workflow systems are not suitable to support big data analytics in the cloud, 2) a new service provisioning platform, called CLAaaS, is needed for big data analytics, and 3) CLAaaS should have the following key features: (a) modular architecture, (b) support for collaboration, (c) support for domain specific analytic software and (d) support for Service Level Agreement.
the proposed conceptual architecture of CLAaaS is an important step towards providing a scalable service provisioning platform for Big Data Analytics.
we have identified the important features of analytic workflow systems and proposed the conceptual architecture of a big data analytics as-a-service provisioning system.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of a framework for the design and deployment of a cloud-based big data analytics platform that will enable the development of domain-specific analytic services and their deployment in a scalable, secure, reliable and cost-efficient manner.
the provision of an analytics as a service in the cloud that is customizable, scalable and cost-efficient.
providing a comprehensive framework for big data analytics in the cloud.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

CLAaaS would enable users to easily access the necessary software, data and hardware resources for their analytics needs in the cloud, while at the same time, providing the service providers with the means to offer a scalable, secure and efficient service provisioning system.
the CLAaaS is a cloud based analytics service provisioning platform that provides an integrated environment for big data analytics, which is customizable, scalable and collaborative.
there is an urgent need to address the challenges in big data analytics in the cloud.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have proposed a conceptual architecture of CLAaaS as an analytics service provisioning platform in the cloud, which is expected to be a promising approach for big data analytics.
CLAaaS will provide the analytic software and the necessary resources for the users in a cloud-based environment.
the CLAaaS platform will enable a new generation of analytic applications that can be easily developed and deployed for various domains and applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a cloud-based big data analytics service can be designed to be modular, scalable and customizable to the users and application domain requirements.
the CLAaaS platform will enable the users to perform analytics on their data with minimum effort, and the service providers will be able to offer analytics as a cloud service to their users.
CLAaaS can serve as an enabling platform for a wide range of analytic applications in different domains.
